newsitem.title: USA: United attendants to see 36 pct raise over 10 yrs.
newsitem.headline: United attendants to see 36 pct raise over 10 yrs.

text.p: United Airlines' flight attendants will get raises and bonus totalling 36 percent over the next 10 years as part of a tentative labour agreement reached earlier this week, the union said Friday.
The agreement also includes a guarantee that 60 percent of all international "block hours" will be flown by U.S.-based crews, the union said in a recorded message to its members.
Block hours refer to the time from which an airlines' brakes are released before a flight until they are reset after landing.
Other details of the labour agreement were not immediately available.

After more than 16 months of negotiations, the flight attendants and United Airlines announced a tentative contract agreement on Monday. The pact must still be approved by the union's 22,000 flight attendants.
United, a unit of UAL Corp., could not be reached for comment.
